# Airspace volumes: #   id          anything unique (EBKT-CTR)
#   name        how it is named (Kortrijk CTR)
#   class       A to G
#   airport     the field it belongs to
#               approach is who a pilot needs to be talking to inside it
#   lower_ft    the floor in feet (0 with SFC for the surface)
#   lower_ref   SFC
#   upper_ft    the ceiling in feet; the volume stops just below it
#   upper_ref   AGL or MSL (a flight level: FL 65 is 6500 with MSL)
#   shape       circle or polygon
#   lat
#   radius_nm   a circle's radius in nautical miles
#   points      a polygon's corners in order
#               repeat of the first corner
#   hours       H24
or as the AIP gives them (informative only)
